risk_summary: The disclosure is quantitatively detailed but relies heavily on forecasts, statistical models, assumptions, and subjective judgments regarding loan collections and cash-flow timing. CECL is expected to reduce reported 2020 net income by approximately 30% to 60%, with potentially material variation depending on portfolio quality, assignment volume, economic conditions, and model refinements. Operating performance is presented positively, but credit-loss estimation and accounting-transition risks materially temper the tone.
